Goin' Down The Road Feelin' Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugar Magnolia** (2 other sources): Sugar Magnolia cuts out just before Sunshine Daydream; Sugar Magnolia has severe pitch problems [3][4]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Jerry didn't start singing until the third verse of the opening Bertha [11]
- **Mr. Charlie** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Mr. Charlie as a standout performance in the first set [19]
- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Casey Jones is named among the standout performances, along with Cryptical, Drums and Other One [19]
- **Goin' Down The Road Feelin' Bad** (1 review): The Goin' Down the Road is described as teetering off a ledge, then slowly crawling back [11]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Other One top-notch [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-08-05.137288.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 163 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1971-08-05.147720.fob-sonyecm22p.flegel.miller.kaslow-todd.boswell.smith.sirmick.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 159 min [3]. Said about its sound: This version is much clearer than shnid 9768, which supplied some between-song tunings; a tape flip occurs during The Other One [3]
- **gd1971-08-05.mtx.chappell.97014.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 15 songs; 112 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [5]. Said about its sound: From Me and Bobby McGee to the end, the audience sources are mono only because of a mic malfunction [5]
- **gd71-08-05.aud.cotsman.9768.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 107 min; rated 4.19/5 by 16 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is well preserved, with solid frequency range, crisp highs and very clear sound; Audience recording is solid and musical, every instrument clear, though with some flaws and a couple of missing tracks; Second-set material seems to come from a different source than the first set [11][13][19]
- **gd1971-08-05.fob-SonyECM22p.miller.88859.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 15 songs; 108 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: Miller's version has more even levels, raised slightly, giving the show more punch than earlier circulating copies [22]

## Around the show

- After Bertha, Bobby told the man holding the microphone to move back forty feet for better recording [13]
- Reviewer rates the following night's audience tape as better than this one [21]
- Both Palladium shows are called among the best audience recordings from this period; the next night also got an improved remaster [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-08-05.137288.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> FLAC/24 [1]. Also: Files are 24-bit/96k FLAC [1]
- **gd1971-08-05.147720.fob-sonyecm22p.flegel.miller.kaslow-todd.boswell.smith.sirmick.flac16**: transferred by pathed by Bian Flegel; source: Harvey Kaslow and Craig Todd aud [3]. Also: Recorded by Harvey Kaslow and Craig Todd; transfers and mastering by Charlie Miller, with pitch-correction help from Joe B. Jones [3]
- **gd1971-08-05.mtx.chappell.97014.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Matrix of SBD(96540) and AUD(94260) with ALT AUD(88559) and PATCH AUD(9768) [5]. Also: This is a matrix mix, but Sugar Magnolia through the end of the show uses audience source only [5]
- **gd71-08-05.aud.cotsman.9768.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Rob Bertrando; transferred by Jeff Krakowka, Jim Hale, and JCotsman; source: Audience [6]. Also: Reviewer has owned an XLII copy of this show for years [12]
- **gd1971-08-05.fob-SonyECM22p.miller.88859.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Harvey Kaslow and Craig Todd; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe B Jones; source: (FOB) Sony ECM-22P -> Master Reel -> Reel -> Dat -> Cool Edit Pro -> CD D [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1971-08-06 GD NRPS Poster - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1971-08-06-gd-nrps-poster/) [24]
